title: ResourceSearchResponse rows live in different fields depending on ResultFormat
answers: Why is resp.Results.Rows empty but TotalHits > 0?
How do I read rows from a Search()/ResourceSearchResponse that could be FIELD_VALUES or RESOURCE_TABLE?
User uniqueness check breaks against older unified-storage servers
How to parse search results compatible with both old and new server versions
body:
Symptom: a consumer of resourcepb.ResourceSearchResponse reads resp.Results.Rows and gets no match even though TotalHits > 0, because the server replied in a different result format.
Root cause: ResourceSearchResponse encodes rows differently per ResultFormat: RESOURCE_TABLE/UNSPECIFIED puts rows in resp.Results.Rows, FIELD_VALUES puts them directly in resp.Rows. Code that only reads one of these breaks against servers using the other format.
Fix pattern: branch on resp.GetResultFormat() and read from the matching field for each case, returning an error for unknown formats; see pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/validate.go:firstUserSearchResultName.
Constraints: needed whenever a request sets ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES (e.g. to request only resource.SEARCH_FIELD_NAME/key-only results) but must stay compatible with older servers that only understand RESOURCE_TABLE.
applies: any code calling ResourceIndexClient.Search and parsing resourcepb.ResourceSearchResponse
says: Total hits shows matches but actual result rows remain empty
Search result parsing fails after upgrading server version
Cannot read search rows consistently across server versions
Search response reports hits but rows are inaccessible
Unified search breaks when server changes result format
search: ResourceSearchResponse encodes rows in format-specific fields: RESOURCE_TABLE/UNSPECIFIED in resp.Results.Rows, FIELD_VALUES in resp.Rows; reading only Results.Rows finds no matches when TotalHits > 0 if the server uses a different format. Fix: branch on resp.GetResultFormat(), read from the matching field for each case, and error on unknown formats; see pkg/registry/apis/iam/user/validate.go:firstUserSearchResultName. Required when setting ResultFormat: FIELD_VALUES for key-only results while maintaining compatibility with older RESOURCE_TABLE-only servers.
